presentationRules: Rendering cannot choose cards or payouts.
Every scene event is idempotent by roundId and sequence number.
The second card may not appear until CARD_PLACED completes for DEAL_TIGER.
Voice text, visemes, result display and settlement use the same round payload.
If animation fails, hold the verified cards and expose a deterministic recovery path; never reroll.
cameraReadability: dealer eyes at least 20 px high on reference viewport
physical card remains at true table scale
rank/suit magnifier appears inside 3D stage at reveal event
shoe and both landing anchors visible without vertical scrolling
HTML wagering controls remain outside the 3D interaction capture area

audioLipsync.fallback: pre-generated verified phrase fragments with timestamp manifest
audioLipsync.prohibited: browser speech synthesis as production authority
